build_vit_small: build a DINOv2 ViT-Small vision transformer model with 384 embed dim and 12 layers
build_vit_base: build a DINOv2 ViT-Base vision transformer model with 768 embed dim and 12 layers
build_vit_large: build a DINOv2 ViT-Large vision transformer model with 1024 embed dim and 24 layers
